run_reconstruct_shapes: run the reconstruct script to reconstruct 3D shapes from SDF samples using a trained DeepSDF decoder
run_reconstruct_with_checkpoint: run reconstruction using a specific checkpoint epoch instead of the latest saved model weights
run_reconstruct_skip_existing: run reconstruction skipping meshes that have already been reconstructed by passing the skip flag
run_reconstruct_custom_iterations: run reconstruction with a custom number of latent code optimization iterations instead of the default 800
run_reconstruct_batch: run reconstruction on a split file containing multiple shape instances from a data source directory
